question:
aHNO₃(aq) + bCa(OH)₂(aq) → Ca(NO₃)₂ + cH₂O

The coefficients a, b and c in the given balanced chemical equation are:
solution:
The correct answer is __**2, 1 and 2, respectively**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The given reaction is a neutralization reaction between **nitric acid (HNO₃)** and **calcium hydroxide (Ca(OH)₂)**.
 
• The correct balanced chemical equation is:

 **2HNO₃ (aq) + 1Ca(OH)₂ (aq) → Ca(NO₃)₂ + 2H₂O**.
 
• Here, **a = 2**, **b = 1**, and **c = 2**, ensuring the number of atoms of each element is balanced on both sides.
 
• The reaction forms **calcium nitrate (Ca(NO₃)₂)** and water (H₂O) as products.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Balancing Chemical Equations:** The number of atoms of each element on the reactant side must be equal to the number on the product side.
 
• **Neutralization Reaction:** When an acid reacts with a base to form a salt and water, it is known as a neutralization reaction.
 
• **Calcium Hydroxide (Ca(OH)₂):** Also known as slaked lime, it is a strong base commonly used in industrial applications.
 
• **Nitric Acid (HNO₃):** A strong acid widely used in fertilizer production and laboratory applications.
 
• **Calcium Nitrate (Ca(NO₃)₂):** A salt formed in this reaction, which is commonly used as a fertilizer.
 
• Water (H₂O) is produced as a byproduct of the neutralization process.
